title: Infinite loop does not complete after end-step discard/damage/draw cycle
reported_text: You must pass on attacking with 8 cards in hand. The discard triggers 1 damage, which triggers you to draw a card on your end step, which triggers the cycle. But it's not working.
diligence: Refreshed live issue body/labels/state and all 2 comments via GitHub API (issue_refresh.json).
Both report attachments (game-state zip, screenshot) fetched via curl: HTTP 404, 36 bytes each (attachment_attempts.json).
No card names in the issue body ('Cards: none detected'); the bug-coverage-classifier comment verdict is cannot_determine.

The issue's own triage comment (2026-08-10) states: 'Without a card/clause mapping, coverage classification cannot distinguish unsupported text from a runtime trigger-loss defect' and its acceptance criteria require reporter follow-up to name the discard, damage, and draw sources.
Searched the workspace for a cached copy of the Discord thread (report id discord:1535814760485093526): none found.
No Discord read capability on this host (no discord skill; thread URL requires authenticated session).
reason: Missing setup information that materially changes the test: no participating cards are identified, the attached saved game state and screenshot have expired (HTTP 404), and the Discord thread cannot be fetched from this host. Inventing a card clause or combo is explicitly forbidden by the playbook, so no trustworthy scenario can be constructed.
next_unblock: Reporter (or a maintainer with Discord access) names the discard source, the 1-damage source, and the end-step draw source; or the saved game state is re-attached with a live link. Then a scenario can be built per the triage acceptance criteria: identify every card, record the first missing trigger and its preceding event, replay the full expected chain.
